blocks.orig: Mountain views and handmade furniture set the scene at Zondela House, located 8 kilometres from Arusha town in the quiet hills of Kambi Chupa, where you can spot Mount Meru from the rooftop bar and catch glimpses of Mount Kilimanjaro on clear mornings. The lodge features 16 rooms with natural brick walls decorated in warm, earth tones, all boasting aircon and wifi, large beds, handmade furnishings and bathrooms with hot showers. The hotel is surrounded by beautiful gardens, has a greenhouse for its vegetables, a rooftop terrace for your sunset cocktails, a swimming pool and spa, and a restaurant serving dishes made of organic ingredients…from the property’s own greenhouse, of course.
blocks.html: At Zondela House, views of the mountains and handmade furniture create the atmosphere. It lies 8 kilometres from Arusha town in the peaceful hills of Kambi Chupa, where Mount Meru is visible from the rooftop bar and, on clear mornings, you can catch sight of Mount Kilimanjaro. The lodge has 16 rooms with natural brick walls in warm, earthy shades, each with aircon and wifi, big beds, handmade furniture and a bathroom with a hot shower. Lovely gardens surround the hotel, and there is a greenhouse for growing vegetables, a rooftop terrace for sunset cocktails, a swimming pool and spa, and a restaurant that cooks with organic ingredients…grown in the property’s own greenhouse, naturally.
